children: Airbus SE (EURONEXT:AIR) delivered 621 aircraft through October, up 6.2% year over year, and maintained its full-year target of around 870, requiring a record fourth quarter. It booked 1,376 aircraft orders in the first ten months of 2026, more than double the 777 orders recorded in the same period of 2025.
: Airbus delivered 621 aircraft through October, up 6.2% year over year, and maintained its full-year target of around 870, requiring a record fourth quarter.
: Airbus SE (AIR) recorded orders for 1,376 aircraft in the first ten months of 2026, more than double the 777 orders booked during the same period in 2025.

: • Airbus SE (AIR) delivered 74 aircraft in October, including four A330s and 39 A321neos. CEO Guillaume Faury said recently identified quality issues affecting some of these models had been contained.
: Airbus may join a separate European fighter-jet project targeting service in the early 2040s. Germany is weighing it as an FCAS alternative and expects to choose by March 2027.
: Spain revised Airbus’s €782.8 million Eurodrone loan schedule after delays. No funds are due in 2026; payments of €250 million, €200 million, €200 million and €132.8 million are set for 2027–2030.
: Airbus SE’s (AIR) H145 light attack helicopters for Germany can fly but aren’t combat-ready due to ammunition issues with onboard cannons. The delivery schedule is under review.
